# Core Contract — Read This First, Every Turn

## 1. Foundation
Client-side **Vite + React 19** SPA with Tailwind CSS v4 and **Base UI** (`@base-ui/react`, never `@radix-ui/*` or `next/*`). Full guide: [component-library.md](./component-library.md).

## 2. The 3 Architectural Layers & Pre-Creation Workflow
1. **Primitives (`src/components/ui/`):** Pure Base UI wrappers, tokens, and controlled AI primitives; never import `blocks/` or `features/`.
2. **Composite Blocks (`src/components/blocks/`):** Controlled UI compositions (props/callbacks only; zero network/DB/auth coupling); never import `features/` or `views/`.
3. **Feature Views (`src/features/` or `src/views/`):** Owns state, queries, auth, and routing.
- **Pre-Creation Workflow:** Inventory `ui/` and `blocks/` first → reuse or extend with props → only build new if nothing fits.

## 3. API Preservation
Never erode component APIs, strip `ref` / `render` props, drop compound subcomponents, or downgrade primitives (`render={<span />}`). Make surgical diffs only.

## 4. Quick Steer (Enforced by Oxlint + Hooks; Full List: [anti-patterns.md](./anti-patterns.md))
- **Controls, Overlays & Imports:** Use Eolas primitives (`<Button>`, `<UnstyledButton>`, `<Input>`, `<Select>`, `<Textarea>`, `<Dialog>`, `<Icon>`) instead of raw HTML controls, unlabelled icon buttons, `fixed inset-0` overlays, or direct `@base-ui/react*`/`@radix-ui/*` imports outside `ui/`.
- **Layout & Shorthands:** `className` is layout-only — no restyling, `[&_...]` reach-in selectors, `!` overrides, `size-*` over `w-X h-X`, `flex/grid gap-*` over `space-x/y-*`, `h-dvh` over `h-screen`, `truncate`, and no `<Icon>` `mr-*`/`ml-*`.
- **Surfaces, Contrast & Motion:** Use Filled / Outline / Soft Wash (no triple-tint), `inverted:*` instead of `dark:*`, `#1C1A18` on callouts/cards, light-surface-safe colors (no `*-tertiary` accents), `outline-offset: 2px` focus vs flush `2px` selection, explicit `transition-[...]` (no `transition-all`, no spring outside `SuccessCheck`), `<ShimmerText>`/`<Skeleton>`, and never nest `<Card>`.
- **Forms, Titles & Copy:** Wrap inputs in `<FieldGroup>` + `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>` (`<InputGroup>` for addons), render `<DialogTitle>`/`<DrawerTitle>` without manual `z-index`, guard `Enter` with `isComposing`, use plain everyday English (1–2 nouns; no dev/DB/CSS jargon), and keep domain views out of `blocks/`.

## 5. Routing Index

| Task | Go here |
|---|---|
| UI/component/styling & WCAG 2.2 AA rules | [design-system.md](./design-system.md) |
| Component architecture, Base UI, navigation taxonomy | [component-library.md](./component-library.md) |
| Banned visual/code/copy patterns | [anti-patterns.md](./anti-patterns.md) |
| Color/type/spacing/motion tokens & component specs | project-root `DESIGN.md` |
| Adding/installing registry items via shadcn CLI | `shadcn` CLI (`npx shadcn@latest add @eolas/...`) — **never** use generic shadcn/Lucide styling patterns; always follow `DESIGN.md` + `design-system.md` |
| Responsive layout, RTL/i18n spacing, or worst-case UI stress testing | `better-layout` / `break-ui` skills |
| Mobile/tablet touch feel or drag/swipe gesture primitives | `mobile-native` / `gestures` skills (always obey `DESIGN.md` motion restraint & WCAG 2.5.1 fallbacks) |
| Motion implementation / tuning | `DESIGN.md` Motion section + `src/globals.css` & `src/components/ui/` motion primitives |
| Live a11y/browser debugging | `a11y-debugging` / `chrome-devtools` skills + Chrome DevTools MCP |
| Plain-English / patient / Easy Read / GDPR copy | `govuk-style` / `patient-communication` / `easy-read` / `gdpr-data-handling` skills |
| Firebase / Firestore / GCP project lookup | `firebase-*` skills + `firebase-mcp-server` (not `google-cloud-firestore`); `google-cloud-resource-manager` `search_projects` |
| Google/Firebase/Cloud docs | `google-developer-knowledge` MCP (`search_documents` fallback on 429) |
| Complex planning | `sequential-thinking` MCP |

> Note: Workspace skills and MCP servers listed above apply in the Eolas UI authoring repo (or any workspace where those tools are installed). In consuming projects without them, rely on `DESIGN.md`, `.agents/rules/`, and your local `src/components/ui/` and `src/components/blocks/` directories.

Precedence: explicit user prompt > `DESIGN.md` > `.agents/rules/` > general conventions.

# Anti-Patterns (Banned) → Required Alternatives

## Linter- & Hook-Enforced Bans (Quick Steer)
- **Controls, Imports & Architecture:** Never write raw `<button>`/`<input>`/`<select>`/`<textarea>`/`<dialog>`, hand-rolled `fixed inset-0` overlays, unlabeled icon-only buttons, upward imports (`ui/` → `blocks/`/`features/`, `blocks/` → `features/`/`views/`), or runtime `@base-ui/react*` / `@radix-ui/*` / other headless imports outside `ui/`.
- **Styling & Selectors:** Pass `className` for layout only — no component restyling, `[&_...]` reach-in selectors, `!` modifiers, `dark:*` (`inverted:*` only), inline styles, raw color hex/palette classes, or arbitrary spacing/sizing (`p-[13px]`).
- **Shorthands & Motion:** Use `size-*` (not `w-X h-X`), `gap-*` (not `space-x/y-*`), `h-dvh` (not `h-screen`), sentence case (not `uppercase`), explicit `transition-[...]` (not `transition-all`), and `--ease-standard` (reserve spring/bounce for `SuccessCheck`).
- **Color, Cards & Icons:** Never use triple-tint pills (pick Filled, Outline + neutral `surface`, or Soft Wash), light-surface `*-tertiary` accents, nested `<Card>`, sparkle icons (`stars`, `auto_awesome`, `auto_fix_high`), decorative emojis, or `<Icon>` `mr-*`/`ml-*`.
- **Code & Copy Safety:** Never leave `// TODO` stubs, `any` / `as unknown as T` / `@ts-ignore`, unguarded `Enter` submission without `isComposing`, positive `tabIndex > 0`, AI cliché buzzwords, dev/DB/CSS jargon, or hardcoded secrets.

## Non-Lintable Design, UX & Accessibility Anti-Patterns

### Color, Badges & Surfaces
- **Banned: Static status dots or text-less indicators** → **Use:** Plain text, `<Badge />`, or functional icons (dots are strictly for live/recording presence paired with text).
- **Banned: `surface-container-low`/`high` fill + `outline-variant` border** → **Use:** `outline` (`#706E6B`) when a neutral tinted surface needs a boundary.
- **Banned: Single-sided accent borders on rounded cards, alerts, or toasts** → **Use:** `border border-transparent` cards, soft semantic container washes (`appearance="wash"`), or neutral-bordered `surface` containers (`border border-outline-variant`) paired with a tinted semantic icon badge (`appearance="surface"` and floating `<Toast />`).
- **Banned: `InlineAlert` for routine tips** → **Use:** `<ClinicianTip />` (`unboxed` in cards; `surface`/`inset` on canvas).

### Interaction, Focus & Accessibility
- **Banned: Hover-only actions or pointer-only drag-and-drop** → **Use:** `:focus-within`, persistent visible touch controls, and keyboard move actions.
- **Banned: Width-based hover reveals (`md:opacity-0`) or primary `(pointer: coarse)` React branching that breaks hybrid iPads** → **Use:** `[@media(hover:hover)_and_(pointer:fine)]` / `[@media(any-hover:hover)_and_(any-pointer:fine)]` CSS capability queries, and keep `<Tooltip>` mounted (`mouseOnly` + `:focus-visible`).
- **Banned: `touch-pan-*` on generic `ScrollArea`, bare `touch-pan-y` without `touch-pinch-zoom`, `-webkit-touch-callout: none` on `<a>`, or dual scroll owners (`min-h-svh` shell + `overflow-y-auto` `<main>`)** → **Use:** Cross-axis `overflow-*-hidden` on `ScrollArea`, `touch-pan-* touch-pinch-zoom` on JS carousels, `touch-none` only on dedicated drag handles, `-webkit-touch-callout: none` strictly on buttons, and a single bounded `h-dvh` scroll owner.
- **Banned: Focus vs. selection ambiguity** (`outline-offset: 0` on selectable containers) → **Use:** Floating `outline-offset: 2px` for focus; flush `2px` border + surface wash for selection.
- **Banned: Unlabelled inputs or placeholder-only labels** → **Use:** `<FieldGroup>` + `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>` (and `<FieldDescription>`/`<FieldError>`).
- **Banned: Trigger downgrades (`render={<span />}`)** → **Use:** Real `<button>` triggers ("Behavior Wraps the Line").
- **Banned: Titleless overlays or manual overlay `z-index` outside `ui/`** → **Use:** `<DialogTitle>`/`<DrawerTitle>` (or `sr-only`) and let `ui/` portals handle stacking.
- **Banned: Ungrouped `*Item`s in `Select`/`Menu`/`ContextMenu`** → **Use:** `Select.Group`, `Menu.Group`, `ContextMenu.Group`.

### Layout, Structure & Component Discipline
- **Banned: `1fr`/`flex` overflow traps or `order-*` on interactive controls** → **Use:** `minmax(0, 1fr)` / `min-w-0`, and match DOM order to tab order.
- **Banned: Unstructured cards, Card Soup ("Card Grid Rain"), or Div Soup wrappers** (`<Box>`, `<Flex>`, `<Spacer>`) → **Use:** `<Card.Header>`/`<Card.Title>`/`<Card.Description>`/`<Card.Action>`/`<Card.Content>`/`<Card.Footer>`, typography/dividers/tables/accordions, and plain semantic elements or `flex`/`grid` `<div>`s.
- **Banned: Desktop FABs, marketing hero banners on workspace views, or empty/Lorem Ipsum mocks** → **Use:** Inline actions, side drawers, page headers, and realistic populated + loading + empty states.
- **Banned: Viewport breakpoints inside reusable components** → **Use:** `@container` on a defined-width wrapper + `@sm:`/`@md:`/`@lg:`.
- **Banned: Start-aligned numeric table columns, stacked vertical icon-over-text buttons, or `<Button>` loops for mode bars** → **Use:** `text-end tabular-nums font-mono`, inline icon + label, and `<ToggleGroup>`.
- **Banned: Arbitrary `0px`-clamped nested radii, sibling height drift, wrapping `ToggleGroup` labels, or asymmetric icon insets** → **Use:** $R_{\text{inner}} = \max(8\text{px}, R_{\text{outer}} - \text{padding})$ (clean `p-1` segmented shells keep `rounded-sm`), matching `sm`/`md`/`lg` height tiers, `Select`/`Radio` in narrow columns, `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap`, and symmetric icon padding.
- **Banned: Manual `relative`/`absolute` input buttons, heavy blurs on inputs/overlays, or pending approvals inside `<Trace>`** → **Use:** `<InputGroup>`, inline editing / `opacity` + `transform` (keep `--blur-*` on micro-primitives), and standalone `<Confirmation>` blocks.
- **Banned: Ad-hoc `@keyframes` shimmer sweeps, single-layer/black/faux shadows, uncapped staggers (>5 items / >200ms), or missing reduced-motion fallbacks** → **Use:** `<ShimmerText>`/`<Skeleton>`, `shadow-ambient`/`shadow-ambient-hover`/`shadow-modal` + real CSS borders, `40ms` stagger capped at 5 items, and `motion-reduce:transition-none`.
- **Banned: Registry bloat** (`blocks/` containing auth/DB/SSE views) → **Use:** `src/features/` or `src/views/`.

### Editorial Copy
- **Banned: Pre-heading eyebrow kickers, decorative `01`/Roman prefixes, `LABEL // YEAR`, invented metrics, or "Click here"/identical links** → **Use:** Direct headings, `[metric]` placeholders, plain everyday 1–2 noun labels, and descriptive unique link text.

# Component Library — Base UI & Architecture

Standardizes on **Base UI** (`@base-ui/react`) across 3 strict one-way layers: `src/components/ui/` (primitives & controlled AI primitives) → `src/components/blocks/` (pure controlled compositions) → `src/features/` / `src/views/` (state, queries, auth, routing). Retains all compound subcomponents, `ref`, `render` props, `composeClassName` / `cn`, and prop aliases via surgical diffs.

## Form & Card Composition
- Wrap every form control in `<FieldGroup className="gap-4">` + `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>` (plus `<FieldDescription>`/`<FieldError>`). Never use placeholder-only labels.
- Compose leading/trailing addons or inline input buttons with `<InputGroup>` + `<InputGroupAddon>` + `<InputGroupInput>` + `<InputGroupButton>`.
- Structure informational `<Card>`s with `<Card.Header>`, `<Card.Title>`, `<Card.Description>`, `<Card.Action>`, `<Card.Content>`, and `<Card.Footer>` (media/game canvases exempt). Use plain layout `<div>`s (`flex`/`grid`), never `<Box>`/`<Flex>`/`<Spacer>`.

## Primitive-Check-First Workflow (Mandatory)
- **Button `colorRole` vs `variant`:** `Button` separates emphasis (`variant="filled" | "soft" | "outline" | "text"`) from palette role (`colorRole`); Emerald (`#00796B`) needs explicit `colorRole="secondary"`, while secondary exit actions ("Cancel", "Back") use `colorRole="neutral"`.
- **Base UI primitives:** Accordion, Alert Dialog, Autocomplete, Avatar, Button, Checkbox, Checkbox Group, Collapsible, Combobox, Context Menu, Dialog, Drawer, Field, Fieldset, Form, Input, Menu, Menubar, Meter, Navigation Menu, Number Field, OTP Field, Popover, Preview Card, Progress, Radio, Scroll Area, Select, Separator, Slider, Switch, Tabs, Toast, Toggle, Toggle Group, Toolbar, Tooltip.
- **Custom `ui/` primitives:** Card, Badge, Chip, InlineAlert, Icon, ClinicianTip, ThinkingOrb, BotAvatar, Avatar.Button, Breadcrumb, Pagination, Empty, Resizable, Attachment, Trace, InputGroup, Confirmation, and motion primitives (`Skeleton`, `TextSwap`, `NotificationBadge`, `TextsReveal`, `NumberPopIn`, `SpinningCounter`, `ShimmerText`, `ErrorShake`, `SuccessCheck`).

1. **Inventory** `src/components/ui/` and `src/components/blocks/` first.
2. **Reuse or extend** existing primitives with props before adding anything new.
3. **Build new** in `ui/` (Base UI wrapper) or `blocks/` (controlled composition) only if nothing fits.

## Upstream Synchronization
```bash
npx @seany9915/eolas-ui sync --dry-run
npx @seany9915/eolas-ui sync
npx @seany9915/eolas-ui add dialog combobox data-table --overwrite
```

## Navigation & Action Taxonomy

| Primitive | Base UI Package | WAI-ARIA Role | Primary Purpose | When to Use | When NOT to Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`NavigationMenu`** | `@base-ui/react/navigation-menu` | `<nav>` / `navigation` | Site & app routing | Top-level header with page routes & sub-nav | Executing commands (Save, Delete), form controls, or toolbars |
| **`Menu`** | `@base-ui/react/menu` | `role="menu"` / `menuitem` | Single-button action dropdown | Isolated action menus, `...` overflow menus | Multi-menu desktop bars (`Menubar`), global nav (`NavigationMenu`), right-click (`ContextMenu`) |
| **`Menubar`** | `@base-ui/react/menubar` + `menu` | `role="menubar"` / `menu` | Desktop app command bar | Document/IDE bars (File/Edit/View) with arrow hopping | Website page routing (`NavigationMenu`) or standalone dropdown (`Menu`) |
| **`ContextMenu`** | `@base-ui/react/context-menu` | `role="menu"` | Pointer-anchored secondary actions | Right-click / long-press shortcuts on rows/nodes | **Never** as the sole way to trigger an action (pair with visible `Menu`/button) |
| **`Toolbar`** | `@base-ui/react/toolbar` | `role="toolbar"` | Persistent action strip | Formatting bars, playback controls (single tab stop) | Hierarchical dropdown menus (`Menubar`) or page nav (`NavigationMenu`) |
| **`Tabs`** | `@base-ui/react/tabs` | `role="tablist"` / `tab` / `tabpanel` | Mutually exclusive views on same page | Switching card/dashboard/profile panels | Executing commands or multi-select filters (`ToggleGroup`) |
| **`ToggleGroup`** | `@base-ui/react/toggle-group` | `role="group"` + `aria-pressed` | Mode/filter selection without panels | Segmented controls, filter bars, Grid/List toggles | Switching entire DOM content panels (`Tabs`) or URL routing (`NavigationMenu`) |

## AI Chat & Base UI Authoring Notes
- **Pending approvals outside `<Trace>`:** Render `[Approve] / [Deny]` as standalone `<Confirmation>` (or `<Questionnaire>`) blocks in the stream, collapsing into `<Trace>` only after resolution.
- **"Behavior Wraps the Line":** Keep disclosure triggers as real `<button>`s — never pass `render={<span />}` or `render={<div />}`.
- **Styling Base UI state:** Drive visuals via Base UI `data-*` attributes (`data-open`, `data-disabled`, `data-starting-style`, `data-ending-style`), wrap `*Item`s in `*Group`, always include `<DialogTitle>`/`<DrawerTitle>`, and let `ui/` portal primitives handle overlay `z-index`.

## The 6-Tier Functional Component Taxonomy
In the Eolas UI authoring repo, see `src/components/playground/registry/registry-manifest.ts`; in consuming apps, inspect `src/components/ui/` and `src/components/blocks/` directly.

| Tier | Category | Directory | Representative Components |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1** | **Primitives** | `src/components/ui/` | `Button`, `Badge`, `Chip`, `Toggle`, `ToggleGroup`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Slider`, `Tabs`, `Icon`, `Spinner` |
| **Tier 2** | **Fields** | `src/components/ui/` | `Field`, `Fieldset`, `InputGroup`, `Combobox`, `Autocomplete`, `OTPField`, `NumberField`, `Calendar` |
| **Tier 3** | **Composed** | `src/components/ui/` & `blocks/` | `Card`, `Table`, `Avatar`, `InlineAlert`, `Empty`, `Accordion`, `Collapsible`, `Toast`, `Chart`, `ClinicianTip` |
| **Tier 4** | **Overlays** | `src/components/ui/` | `Dialog`, `AlertDialog`, `Drawer`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `Menu`, `ContextMenu`, `PreviewCard` |
| **Tier 5** | **Shell** | `src/components/ui/` | `Sidebar`, `Breadcrumb`, `Pagination`, `NavigationMenu`, `Toolbar` |
| **Tier 6** | **Clinical AI & Conversation** | `src/components/ui/` & `blocks/` | `ChatMessage`, `Trace`, `Reasoning`, `ThinkingOrb`, `Confirmation`, `Attachment`, `Sources`, `Checkpoint` |

## Known Component Traps & Edge-Case Guardrails
1. **Command Inline Mount Scroll-Jump:** Pass controlled `value` + `onValueChange` to `cmdk` so initial render doesn't jump the page.
2. **Sidebar Preview Isolation:** Wrap embedded sidebars in `<SidebarProvider className="min-h-0">` with `<Sidebar collapsible="none">`.
3. **DirectionProvider RTL Sync:** Mirror `dir={direction}` onto the container DOM element alongside `<DirectionProvider>`.
4. **Resizable Panels v4:** Use `orientation="horizontal"` and percentage strings (`defaultSize="40%"`), not `direction` or numbers.
5. **Control Height Synchrony:** Keep the outer bounding-box tiers (`sm` 44px, `md` 48px, `lg` 56px) across bordered wrappers (`h-*`/`min-h-*` + `items-stretch`) rather than inner inputs.
6. **WebKit IME Composition Timing:** Beyond checking `isComposing`, guard against WebKit firing `compositionend` on the same tick just before `Enter` `keydown`.
7. **Focus Recovery & Move Stability:** Move focus to next sibling, previous sibling, or container/add trigger when deleting list items; never use array index `key`s on reorderable lists (`Sortable`, `Queue`).
8. **Single Tab-Stop Roving Focus:** Expose a single `Tab` stop with Arrow-key navigation (`Toolbar` or roving `tabIndex`) on chip bars and action strips.
9. **Collapsed Panel Accessibility:** Use `hidden="until-found"` (with `beforematch` auto-expand) or `hidden`/`inert` — never `opacity-0` or `max-h-0` alone.
10. **Keyboard Parity for Reorder & Multi-Select:** Support keyboard reordering (`Space`/`Enter` + Arrows or Move Up/Down buttons) with `aria-live` announcements.

## Reference
- Base UI docs: https://base-ui.com/react/overview/quick-start
- Base UI llms.txt: https://base-ui.com/llms.txt
- Base UI animation guide: https://base-ui.com/react/handbook/animation

# Design System & Accessibility Rules

**Source of truth:** [DESIGN.md](../../DESIGN.md). *(Oxlint already enforces raw colors, arbitrary values, `size-*`/`gap-*`/`h-dvh` shorthands, `dark:*`, `!`, `uppercase`, `transition-all`, spring easing, triple-tint, light-surface `*-tertiary`, icon margins/labels, and component restyle contracts.)* Check [anti-patterns.md](../rules/anti-patterns.md) before finishing.

## Styling & Surface Judgment
- **Tailwind v4:** Theme tokens live in `src/globals.css` (or `src/eolas-theme.css`). Never create `tailwind.config.js`/`.ts` or invent custom hex codes.
- **Icons & Loading:** Material Symbols only via `<Icon size="..." />` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`); use `<Icon.Toggle />` / `<Icon.CrossFade />` for state swaps, `<ShimmerText />` for text shimmer, and `<Skeleton />` / `<Skeleton.Reveal />` for placeholders.
- **Inverted Surfaces (`<Card prominence="inverted">`):** Scope styling via `[data-surface="inverted"]` / `inverted:*`, not `.dark`.
- **Container Text Split:** Callouts, `InlineAlert`s, and tinted cards keep `#1C1A18` (`text-on-surface`) body copy without colored perimeter borders; `<Badge />`/`<Chip />` `variant="soft"` pills drop borders and use semantic `on-*-container` ink.

## Layout, Typography & Responsive Structure
- **Units & Type:** Relative units (`rem`/`em`) only. Body copy starts at `1rem` (`body-md`); dense tables/sidebars/metadata use `body-sm`/`caption` (`0.875rem`). Headings use `font-heading` + `text-wrap: balance`; prose uses `font-sans` + `text-wrap: pretty`. Never justify text.
- **Data Tables:** End-align (`text-end`) numeric `<th>`/`<td>` cells with `tabular-nums font-mono` (or `numeric: true` on `<Table />`).
- **Control Height Synchrony:** Match outer bounding-box tiers (`sm` 44px, `md` 48px, `lg` 56px per `DESIGN.md` 3-family matrix) across row/grid siblings. Use `Select`/`Radio` when `ToggleGroup` labels would wrap in narrow columns, and keep `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` on row buttons.
- **Concentric Radii:** Tight `p-1` segmented shells (`ToggleGroup`) step down to `rounded-sm` (`4px`); nested cards/media follow $R_{\text{inner}} = \max(8\text{px}, R_{\text{outer}} - \text{padding})$ (clamped to `rounded` / `8px`).
- **Container vs. Viewport Queries:** Declare `@container` (`w-full` or grid cell — never `<table>`, `<tr>`, or auto-sized flex) + `@sm:`/`@md:`/`@lg:` inside reusable components/blocks; reserve viewport breakpoints (`sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`) for page shells and the 12/8/4 grid.

## WCAG 2.2 AA & Verification
- **Contrast & Tap Targets:** Never convey state by color alone. Maintain `24×24px` minimum everywhere and `44×44px` (`2.75rem`) for standalone controls/dismiss actions without horizontal hit-target overlap in dense grids.
- **Forms, Auth & Focus:** Wrap inputs in `<FieldGroup>` + `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>` (never placeholder-only), auto-focus invalid controls (`<Form focusFirstInvalid />`), never block paste/autofill on auth inputs, keep `scroll-padding-block-start`/`end` for sticky bars, set `enterKeyHint`/`inputMode`/`autoComplete`, use semantic landmarks, never hide `:focus-visible` outlines, and never convey meaningful text solely via CSS `content`.
- **Touch, Tablet & Scroll Discipline:** Give each shell a single scroll owner (`h-dvh overflow-hidden` + `overscroll-contain` `<main>` with `AppShell`-scoped root lock, or document scroll — never both). Never infer touch from width (`md:opacity-0`) or branch React on primary `(pointer: coarse)` (which breaks hybrid Magic Keyboard iPads); gate hover/mouse affordances with `[@media(hover:hover)_and_(pointer:fine)]` or `[@media(any-hover:hover)_and_(any-pointer:fine)]` and keep `<Tooltip>` mounted for `:focus-visible`. Never set `touch-pan-*` on generic `ScrollArea` (use cross-axis `overflow-*-hidden`), pair single-axis JS carousels with `touch-pinch-zoom`, scope `touch-none` strictly to dedicated drag handles, provide `:active` feedback + `touch-manipulation` on touch controls, keep `-webkit-touch-callout: none` off `<a>`, and pad fixed edge chrome with vertical + horizontal `env(safe-area-inset-*, 0px)`.
- **Composers, Shortcuts & Motion:** Handle mobile virtual keyboards (`visualViewport`/safe bottom insets) on docked composers, format `mod+` per OS in `<Kbd>` with `aria-keyshortcuts`, restrict `--blur-*` to micro-primitives (`<TextSwap />`, `<Skeleton.Reveal />`, `<Icon.Toggle />`), include `motion-reduce:transition-none`, use plain everyday English UI copy, and verify live Desktop (top + scrolled), Tablet (`744×1133` iPad Mini / `820×1180` iPad), and Mobile (`390×844`) views via Chrome DevTools MCP + `a11y-debugging` (plus physical iPad/iPhone hardware for WebKit/Safari `dvh`, short-container `overscroll`, and `:active`).

# AGENTS.md

> Mirrors `.agents/rules/00-core-contract.md` (single source of truth) and `DESIGN.md` for tools following [agents.md](https://agents.md).

## Foundation & Architecture

- **Stack:** Client-side **Vite + React 19** SPA with Tailwind CSS v4 and **Base UI** (`@base-ui/react`). Never generate Next.js App Router files (`page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `route.ts`), `next/*` imports, or `@radix-ui/*`.
- **3 Strict One-Way Layers:** `src/components/ui/` (primitives & controlled AI primitives; zero business/network logic) → `src/components/blocks/` (controlled compositions; props/callbacks only) → `src/features/` or `src/views/` (state, queries, auth, routing). Check `ui/` and `blocks/` before creating components.
- **API Preservation:** Never erode component APIs, strip `ref` / `render` props, drop compound subcomponents, or downgrade primitives during bug fixes or styling tweaks.

## Oxlint-Enforced Steer

- **Primitives & Imports:** Use `<Button>`/`<UnstyledButton>`, `<Input>`, `<Select>`, `<Textarea>`, `<Dialog>`, and `<Icon>` instead of raw HTML controls, unlabelled icon buttons, `fixed inset-0` overlays, or direct `@base-ui/react/*` / `@radix-ui/*` imports outside `ui/`.
- **Styling & Selectors:** Pass `className` for layout only — no component restyling, `[&_...]` reach-in selectors, `!` overrides, `dark:*` (`inverted:*` only), `space-x/y-*` (`gap-*`), `w-X h-X` (`size-X`), `h-screen` (`h-dvh`), `uppercase`, `transition-all`, spring easing outside `SuccessCheck`, triple-tint pills, light-surface `*-tertiary`, nested `<Card>`, sparkle icons, inline styles, or `as any` / `@ts-ignore`.

## Design & Copy

- Follow `DESIGN.md` and `.agents/rules/` (`design-system.md`, `component-library.md`, `anti-patterns.md`).
- Wrap inputs in `<FieldGroup>` + `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>` (use `<InputGroup>` for addons); include `<DialogTitle>`/`<DrawerTitle>`; write plain everyday English UI copy (1–2 nouns; no dev/DB/CSS jargon).
